record.name: Shield Barrier

universal_access.description: Personal energy shield technology for protection

record.narrative: You activate a personal energy shield that absorbs incoming damage, translucent barrier shimmering into existence around your body. The power manifests as hexagonal energy patterns flickering where attacks impact, the shield dissipating kinetic force and energy alike until its charge depletes.
record.flavor_text: "Shields up. Always shields up." - Mercenary Survivor

manifestation.description: activating belt-mounted or wrist-mounted shield generator

base_effect.description: You activate an energy shield that absorbs damage.

mechanics.notes: Gain 2d6 + Tech modifier temporary HP from shield

class_synergies.narrative: The Engineer's shield technology expertise creates optimized barriers. They've calibrated power flow and emitter patterns for maximum efficiency, their shields absorbing more damage from the same energy expenditure through superior engineering.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Engineers gain an additional 1d6 temporary HP (3d6 total).

species_synergies.narrative: Human adaptability allows them to recalibrate shields on the fly. They adjust frequencies to resist specific damage types, optimize coverage for tactical situations, making standard shields perform beyond specifications through improvisation.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Humans can choose one damage type to have resistance against while shield is active.

faction_synergies.narrative: The Rebel Alliance has perfected shield efficiency through resource scarcity. Their versions can recharge from absorbed energy, environmental power sources, or even friendly fire—necessity breeding innovation in shield technology.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Rebel shields regain temporary HP equal to half any energy damage they absorb.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: Describe the translucent barrier shimmering to life, hexagonal energy patterns flickering where impacts hit. Show the shield absorbing damage—kinetic force dispersing across the surface, energy blasts dissipating harmlessly. The barrier should feel reliably protective.
llm_guidance.tactical_notes: Shield Barrier grants 2d6 + Tech modifier temporary HP for 1 hour, costing 1 Tech Point. Excellent preemptive defense that lasts through multiple encounters. The temp HP absorbs all damage types. No concentration required makes it reliable protection.
narrative_hooks: Shield barrier saves character from killing blow, flickering out after
The shield's energy signature reveals advanced technology to enemies
Shield failure at critical moment creates desperate situation

image_generation.base_prompt: A dramatic digital painting of a warrior protected by an energy shield barrier. A translucent field surrounds them, hexagonal energy patterns flickering where an attack impacts. The barrier absorbs the damage, dissipating kinetic force across its surface. The scene captures reliable technological protection through personal shield technology.
